name: io.github.onlsol/domain-discovery-remotify-mcp
description: Domain search and lookup for any MCP client: availability, registrar, dates, NS, MX and SPF.

tools.name: check_domains
tools.description: Bulk-check domains. Returns status (available|premium|reserved|registered|expired|redemption|pending_delete|unknown|invalid|unsupported_tld), action, and an order_url on our host. 'available' is registry-confirmed (RDAP not-found + no DNS delegation); 'unknown' is NOT confirmed. registration_details on registered-family results are published data from the registry's RDAP response (dates, registrar, nameservers, and the published registrant name and organization only); every null field carries a reason. Held results also carry dns_overview, read from DNS during the check: the nameservers DNS answered for the name, its mail exchangers (MX), and its initial SPF record parsed into structure. SPF include and redirect targets are disclosed but never resolved, and the policy is parsed, never evaluated, never validated end to end, and never attributed to any provider. If meta.notice is present, relay it to the user.
